description: World Port Index is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Latin America and the Caribbean (ROLAC). The World Port Index shows locations, physical characteristics, facilities, and services offered by major ports around the world. This dataset is created by the Maritime Security Office of the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA) to document the locations and features of major ports around the world. Coverage: not tied to one country in the listing. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Latin America and the Caribbean (ROLAC). Its tags are ports. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-08-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
